title: Canopy hands comparison
type: code-native fixed-template character contour and hand-layering study
status: bounded 2D drawing study; not a source animation or 3D intersection proof
basedOn: Iteration 14 Canopy Hop renderer and shared six pose records

variants.name: Broad canopy control
variants.description: Broad fixed shell; original hand-behind-shell draw order.

variants.name: Foreground mittens
variants.description: Same broad fixed shell and attached rotating arms; mitten shapes are redrawn above the shell.

variants.name: Reduced cowl sweep
variants.description: Smooth fixed shell with reduced lower lateral sweep; original hand-behind-shell draw order.

characterDirection.shared: All variants keep the same head, torso/face placement, seed, palette, six pose records, timing, limb transforms, render envelope and ground marks. Only cowl sweep and mitten draw order vary.

renderer.name: drawFrame/drawSower Canvas 2D
renderer.pausedBehavior: Default paused. One cancellable play loop; no animation-frame callback while paused. prefers-reduced-motion disables Play.

controls.poseSelector: Native range, six discrete positions; keyboard operable and pauses playback

referencePins.role: Goat 4 preference anchor: warm palette, friendly arch eyes, crown stripe, seed chestmark and compact attached mitten direction.
Shared pose/data and prior canopy sheet reference.
Textual notes on Goat 4 preference anchor.

exports.kind: three variants × six poses contact sheet

observations: Broad shell control hides the mitten cues at neutral.
Redrawing the same attached mittens above the shell makes round, compact hand ends readable while the arms remain joint-attached.
Reducing the cowl sweep narrows the lower contour and reduces the skirt/flower impression.
All pose labels and variants are in-frame; no character anatomy changes across poses.

verification.visualExportReview: Neutral comparison and 18-pose sheet inspected; all poses/captions fit inside image bounds.

limitations: Foreground layering is a 2D study, not proof of 3D garment/hand intersection.
No conclusion about candy moldability or manufacturing.
Authored visual comparison, not measured preference evidence.
Proposed poses/timing do not constitute source animation or production timing.
